chunk_list: SILEX PILOT DEPLOYMENT REPORT V1.0 1. Summary SILEX was deployed in the Santa Marina City Council pre-production environment after network configuration, named accounts, secrets, and API contract tests were completed. This report documents infrastructure, versions, steps, incidents, results, and rollback. The first planned window was postponed because authorized network addresses and two municipal accounts were missing. The executed window took place on 21 and 22 September 2026. The environment became available for training and internal tests before the pilot began in October. 2. Components Deployment includes the API service, semantic database, proxy, authentication, monitoring, logs, backups, and a candidate dataset. Every component has a version, checksum, configuration, and owner. 3. Security Access uses the VPN. Accounts are named. Secrets are exchanged through a secure channel and do not appear in repositories or emails.

The administration endpoint is limited to the municipal network. Logs remove credentials and complete bodies. 4. Data The candidate load contains authorized procedures, vocabularies, units, legal bases, and version relations. The municipal register and other restricted datasets remain outside. The load retains a manifest, source, licence, and counts. Deployment record 1 Deployment step 1 is to confirm the window and participants.
